title: Chapter 115
text:
"Probably someone from Division 13." Han Xiao thought for a while and understood the reason. He did not show any abnormalities and continued walking at a normal pace. He bumped into the pedestrians and stole their hard objects, keys, phones, and the like. After turning a corner, he suddenly flashed in and threw the hard objects, breaking all the surveillance cameras.

Not far away, in a command vehicle disguised as a truck, the screen of the surveillance camera turned black. Di Su Su frowned and said into the communicator, "This guy is very alert. Follow him."

The person in charge of tracking him chased after him, but he was shocked to find that Han Xiao had disappeared.

Di Su Su's face was solemn. Mo Ran was worried about these assassins, so he sent them to monitor them. The other four assassins were all under surveillance. Perhaps they had noticed the spies, but they had all silently allowed it. Only Mr. Black had shaken them off. Di Su Su remembered that it was this man in black who had given her a sense of danger.

"Gather all the surveillance cameras in the city and find him."

The information was quickly gathered and analyzed with the facial recognition system. The results shocked Di Su Su.

There was no one who matched the description!

"Wait, have I seen this situation before?!"

Di Su Su immediately thought of Han Xiao, who had disappeared from the face of the earth.

However, she immediately shook her head. She felt that she was being too suspicious. How could every missing person be related to Han Xiao? There were so many capable people in the world.

"Looks like I've been under too much pressure recently. Sigh, Xiao Linlin has been busy with the debt collectors and has no way to relax." Di Su Su sighed.

…

Seagull City, South District, 53rd Street. This was a famous antique street.

In a deserted antique shop on 53rd Street, Li Xin was locking the door and preparing to close the shop.

Knock, knock, knock. Suddenly, someone knocked on the door. Li Xin looked up in surprise. An extremely handsome man was looking at her through the window. They were less than 20 centimeters apart.

Li Xin's heart skipped a beat. Her face quickly turned red as if she was drunk.

"You … What do you want to buy?"

The handsome man knocked on the window. "Please let me in first. I want to look at the antiques."

"Oh, oh, okay, okay." Li Xin hurriedly opened the door and looked left and right at the handsome man. No matter how she looked at him, she felt that he was perfect. She followed closely behind the handsome man, her hands clasped nervously behind her back.

The handsome man looked at Li Xin, smiled and asked, "Are you the owner of this shop?"

He smiled! This smile was too lethal! Li Xin could barely suppress the urge to scream.

Seeing that Li Xin did not speak, the handsome man approached Li Xin and asked condescendingly, "Are you the owner?"

The moment the handsome man approached her, Li Xin's brain buzzed. She was so excited that she almost lost her five senses. She did not hear what he said at all. Her heart was in a mess.

Seeing Li Xin's infatuated expression, Han Xiao was puzzled. He touched the facial simulator on his face and asked curiously, "What did I change into this time?"

He decided not to waste any more time and directly stated his intentions.

"Where is Tang Shu?"

Li Xin's expression changed drastically. She hurriedly retreated, knocking over a piece of furniture.

Han Xiao lifted his shirt and revealed his gun. "Take me to him."

…

The two of them arrived at a factory that had been abandoned for many years. Li Xin nervously knocked on the door.

The person inside saw Li Xin through the peephole and opened the door.

This was a man who was so thin that he looked like he was about to be dehydrated. It made people worry that a gust of wind would blow him away. His appearance had broken through a new realm of wretchedness. He looked like a rat that had turned into a demon, making people lose their appetite. His pair of small eyes looked around like a thief, as if he would immediately escape at the slightest sign of trouble.

This wretched man who looked like a zombie had a name that matched his characteristics — Tang Shu!

He was a treasure thief and a mysterious merchant. He sold all kinds of strange things, including world gossip. His whereabouts were hard to predict. The only chance to meet him was the prize-pool mission in Seagull City.

The prize-pool mission was competitive. It allowed many people to complete it at the same time. Each player had to pay some experience to accept the mission. These experience points would be accumulated in the prize-pool and awarded to the few people with the best results.

Han Xiao instantly entered the door. When Tang Shu saw a stranger, he immediately turned around and ran like a frightened rat.

"Stop right there. If you run one more step, there will be a second hole in your butt." Han Xiao fired a shot in front of Tang Shu.

Tang Shu hurriedly stopped. He froze on the spot, not daring to move. Cold sweat flowed down his back as he stammered, "You … Are you Jack's man? After I finish this, I will definitely return the money I owe him!"

"I have nothing to do with Jack. I'm looking for you for something else."

"What is it?" Tang Shu carefully recalled the people he had offended. However, there were too many of them. He could not pinpoint who he was looking for.

"I want to take part in this business."

Tang Shu was stunned. He looked at Li Xin. "Did you find him too?"

Li Xin was also confused. "No."

"My background is not important. Sincerity is the most important thing." Han Xiao put away his gun and calmed the atmosphere.

The normal way to trigger a mission was to get Li Xin's approval (in other words, to gain favorability) before finding Tang Shu to trigger the mission. However, Han Xiao skipped this process and used force to threaten them. After a friendly discussion, he finally convinced the skeptical Tang Shu and Li Xin …

There was nothing they could do even if they did not believe him. Tang Shu estimated that if he said no, he would be shot in the butt. He was very decisive.

"Although I don't know why you are here to help, you seem very sincere …" Tang Shu glanced at Han Xiao's gun and coughed dryly. "Anyway, I welcome you to join."

You have used 2,000 EXP to activate the Prize Pool Mission [Return the Antiques]!

Mission Introduction: Li Xin's family antiques have been seized by the Municipal Museum. Your help is needed.

Requirement: Return ten antiques to Li Xin.

Number of participants: 1

Accumulated Prize Pool: 102000 EXP

Mission Requirement: Each antique returned will give 10% of the Prize Pool EXP.

Note: Antiques are very fragile. It is best not to break them.

After the two's explanation, Han Xiao understood the cause and effect.

Li Xin's father owned ten famous antiques. When the Municipal Museum found out, the curator personally came and explained the various historical and cultural meanings of the antiques. He begged Li Xin's father to put the antiques on display in the museum. Li Xin's father was stunned and agreed. Later, when Li Xin's father passed away, Li Xin wanted to take back the antiques. However, the Municipal Museum turned hostile and denied it. They even asked the security guards to bar Li Xin at the door. They wanted to take the antiques for themselves.

The Municipal Museum had a strong connection with the government. Li Xin had no choice but to place her hopes on a thief. By chance, she hired Tang Shu.

Li Xin's thoughts could be summarized in one sentence.

Even if I break the antiques, I will not hand them over to the country!

After listening to Li Xin's story, Han Xiao coughed dryly and said seriously, "You little comrade, your thoughts are very dangerous. How can you call this stealing when it comes to the country? You urgently need to improve your political awareness."

Li Xin was confused. What are you talking about? Didn't you come to me and ask for help?

Tang Shu whispered at the side, "Water must have entered your brain."

Han Xiao's ears twitched. He suddenly turned his head and looked at Tang Shu. His eyes were bright. He only looked away when Tang Shu's hair stood on end.
